lineage.description: IOM conducted direct observational assessments of displacement sites across Nepal following the 2015 earthquake, collecting data through 5 rounds of the Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM). Site-level data on displaced populations and camp management conditions were compiled into standardized CCCM and DTM formats for humanitarian response coordination.
